name: The General's Response
summary: In Lakeshire, General Marcus Jonathan answers a plea for aid as Redridge faces danger. His dispatch acknowledges Magistrate Solomon’s appeal against the Blackrock orcs and gnolls, but sends no immediate reinforcements from Stormwind.

sections.title: A Diplomatic Standoff
sections.body: Magistrate Solomon asks Stormwind City for troops to defend Redridge from gathering Blackrock orc clans and Gnoll warbands. General Marcus Jonathan replies that he has sent the plea to the throne, but no soldiers are coming now. He orders the letter returned to Lakeshire. Solomon is troubled by the delay and suspects something is wrong with Stormwind’s leaders.

faq.q: What is written in The General's Response?
faq.answer: General Marcus Jonathan mourns the dead and says he will tell the King of Lakeshire’s plight. He hopes to bring reinforcements, and confides that His Majesty has been scarce and acting oddly.

faq.q: Why can't General Marcus Jonathan send troops to Lakeshire?
faq.answer: General Marcus Jonathan is waiting for the King’s response before promising reinforcements. In confidence, he tells Solomon that His Majesty has been scarce and acting oddly.

faq.q: How does Magistrate Solomon react to the letter?
faq.answer: Magistrate Solomon is deeply unsettled by the dispatch. Stormwind’s delay makes no sense while Lakeshire faces such danger, and he fears the neglect points to worse trouble in the kingdom.

angles.text: Stormwind’s response shows the strain on the Grand Alliance. Lakeshire bleeds while the court seems strangely unresponsive to its plight.
For humans of the southern kingdoms, the delayed reply shows a growing rift between those fighting to survive in the provinces and the secluded nobility in Stormwind Keep.
